overview: UniDigital is a comprehensive, enterprise-grade university portal automating all academic, administrative, and financial processes from admission to graduation. Features role-based dashboards for Admin, Lecturer, Student, Bursary, HR, and HOD with modules covering course registration, CBT exams, results pipeline, payroll, hostel management, graduation clearance, alumni portal, and more.
features: Complete results pipeline from Lecturer to Senate Board
CBT exam engine with question bank and analytics
Hostel room/bed allocation and occupancy management
Timetable with conflict detection and auto-resolve
Bursary finance depth with debt aging and reconciliation
Student disciplinary records and appeal workflow
Internal memo/circular system with acknowledgment tracking
Data export center for all datasets
